Your Cold Outreach Partner | Bettr Reach - Your Cold Outreach Specialist

Struggling to get consistent LEADs every month for your business?

##### Start conversations with your dream clients without the hassle of reaching out yourself.

200+ Companies that we have gotten replies from, for our CLIENTS

and MANY MORE……

The Foundation 

## A Done-for-You Outreach system, built and managed

So you can focus on closing deals

### Onboarding Form

To understand your target audience, & plan a strategy.

### Tech-Stack Implementation

We build, structure and manage everything at our end.

### Target Audience Listing

Based on your requirement, we will collect a list.

### Copywriting

We design a purpose driven script for responses.

### Campaign Creation & Management

We handle everything from sending, follow-up and forward lead that show interest.

## Meet the Founder

# Subrat Behera

###### Founder & CEO

After running multiple cold email campaigns over the past two years, I’ve learned exactly what increases the chances of making people reply, and what could make them ignore you.

I’ve tested various angles, cold email scripts, and follow-up strategy until I built a system that consistently gets B2B businesses replies, meetings, and clients, without doing the guess work or wasting time.

## Real People. Real Results.

 1. What exactly does Bettr Reach do? 

We help B2B companies get qualified client conversations using cold email: no spam, no bots, just smart manual outreach.

 2. Who do you usually work with? 

Founders, agency owners, and marketing heads who want a predictable flow of leads but don’t have time to run outbound themselves.

 3. How is this different from buying email tools or lists? 

We handle the entire system, prospect research, copy, outreach, and follow-ups, so you only focus on replying to warm leads.

 4. Do you use automation for sending? 

No. Every email is manually scheduled and verified to protect your domain reputation and keep deliverability near 99%.

 5. What kind of results can I expect? 

Typically 8–20+ qualified replies per month once campaigns stabilize, depending on your niche and offer.

 6. What happens during the trial period? 

We target 500 verified prospects, run your campaigns, and share positive replies in real time, so you see results before scaling.

 7. How long before I start seeing leads? 

Most clients start getting positive replies within 2–4 weeks of campaign launch once warm-up and testing are complete.

 8. Why not just run ads instead? 

Ads chase people, cold email starts real conversations with decision-makers who actually match your ICP.

## Let’s Work Together

Book a FREE focused strategy session with US to see if our Cold outbound fits your business.

We’ll understand your goals, challenges, and ideate your TAM, so you leave with a clear picture of the channel’s potential and the next steps to turn it into a predictable revenue engine.

Before they realize it, 80% of their day is gone—and they’ve barely had time to focus on real sales and marketing tasks.

Sound familiar?

This is where Bettr Reach steps in.

We handle the time-consuming tasks that keep your team from what matters most—engaging with interested prospects and closing deals.

Here’s what we do:
✅ Find and engage your ideal customers through AI-driven email campaigns.
✅ Nurture leads with strategic follow-ups that turn cold prospects into warm opportunities.
✅ Deliver Sales Qualified Leads (SQLs) and Marketing Qualified Leads (MQLs), ready for your team to convert.

By partnering with Bettr Reach, your sales and marketing team can focus on what they do best—building relationships, having meaningful conversations, and closing more deals.

Stop wasting time. Start scaling.

Let’s talk about how we can help your team become more productive and drive measurable growth.

The Reality

## Sound familiar?

" Our pipeline runs on referrals — and it's starting to feel fragile. "

Referrals are great until they dry up. If you can't predict where next month's new business is coming from, you don't have a pipeline — you have luck.

" We tried cold outreach before. It was a waste of time and money. "

Bad copy. Wrong targets. No infrastructure. Most cold outreach fails because it's done wrong — not because outbound doesn't work. There's a difference.

" We just don't have the time or bandwidth to manage another thing. "

You're running a business. The last thing you need is another tool to learn or another agency to babysit. You need someone who takes it completely off your plate.

If you can't predict next month's revenue, you don't own a business — you own a job.

Every founder we speak to says the same thing: "We're busy, but we've got no idea where the next deal is coming from." That's not a sales problem — it's a system problem. We install the system that turns outbound from a coin-flip into a forecast.

Build My Pipeline

Why Us

## Why South East businesses choose AG Quantum Group

### Flexible Performance Pricing

Tailored to your business. Tied to results.

Pricing is bespoke to every client based on your deal size, market and goals — but the principle never changes: your investment is tied directly to qualified meetings booked, not vague 'activity'. No bloated retainers. Just outcomes.

### Fully Managed Outreach

We handle everything. You handle nothing.

Domain setup, inbox warm-up, prospect research, copywriting, reply management — it's all on us. Your only job is to show up to the calls we book.

### AI-Powered Personalisation

Precision outreach at scale.

We use tools like Clay to research and personalise every sequence. Your prospects receive messages that feel like they were written specifically for them — because they were.

### South East UK Specialists

We know your market because it's our market.

We work exclusively with South East UK businesses turning over £5m+. We understand your buyers, your landscape and what it takes to open doors here.

Stop hiring more salespeople to fix a broken top of funnel.

Adding a £60k BDR to chase cold leads is the most expensive way to plug a pipeline gap. We deliver the same outcome — qualified meetings on your calendar — for a fraction of the cost, with zero management overhead, and you only pay when it works.

See If We're A Fit

The Process

## From zero to booked calls in weeks, not months.

Completely hands-off. Here's exactly what happens once you come on board.

04

05

Behind The Scenes

## The actual stack we build around your business.

A real look at the tools, infrastructure and workflows powering every meeting we book — fully managed, end to end.

You Hop On The Zoom Call

What's Included

## Everything you need. Nothing you don't.

A fully managed outbound system, built from the ground up for your business.

### Dedicated Sending Infrastructure

Purpose-built domains, professional mailbox setup and full SPF, DKIM and DMARC configuration. Your outreach lands in inboxes — not spam.

### Inbox Warm-Up

Every inbox is warmed up before a single email is sent. This protects deliverability and ensures campaigns start strong from day one.

### Prospect Research & List Building

We identify and verify your ideal prospects using AI-powered tools. Targeted by industry, size, location and job title — no generic lists.

### Personalised Copywriting

Every sequence is written specifically for your business and your buyers. Messages that feel human, relevant and worth responding to.

### Multi-Channel Cold Email Campaigns

We run multiple inbox-warmed sending domains in parallel so your message reaches more decision-makers without ever hitting spam.

### Reply Management

We handle every response — including objections — so you never have to monitor another inbox. We book straight into your calendar.

### Reporting & Transparency

You'll always know exactly what's happening with your campaigns. Clear, regular reporting with no smoke and mirrors.

### Flexible, Performance-Based Pricing

Bespoke to every client and tied directly to qualified meetings booked. Your investment scales with your results — never the other way around.

Imagine opening your laptop on Monday and seeing 5 qualified meetings already booked.

No chasing. No prospecting. No "where's our next deal coming from?" anxiety. Just a calendar full of decision-makers who've already raised their hand and want to talk to you. That's not a fantasy — it's what our clients wake up to every week.

Andy and Livia with their family, founders of AG Quantum Group

About Us

## We're not an agency. We're your growth partners.

AG Quantum Group was founded by Andy and Livia — a husband and wife team who believe great client results and genuine personal service should never be mutually exclusive.

- Andy — Co-Founder & Head of Client Delivery. Owns onboarding, campaign execution and client success — making sure every account is set up properly and every booked meeting actually turns up.
- Livia — Co-Founder & Head of Growth. Leads campaign strategy, offer positioning and the outbound playbook that gets your calendar filled with the right kind of meetings.

We saw too many good companies stuck in the same trap — great at what they do, but invisible to the clients they should be working with. Relying on word of mouth. Hoping the phone rings. Watching competitors win business that should have been theirs.

We created AG Quantum Group to fix that.

Every client gets our direct attention, our honest advice, and a system built specifically for their business. You're never passed to a junior account manager. When you work with us — you work with us.

Andy Groves, Founder of AG Quantum Group

Meet The Founder

### Andy Groves

Co-Founder & Head of Client Delivery — AG Quantum Group Ltd

I've spent years inside sales-driven businesses watching great founders get stuck on the same problem: a brilliant offer with no predictable way to put it in front of buyers. AG Quantum Group exists to fix exactly that — a fully managed outbound engine that delivers qualified meetings, not vanity metrics. You'll deal with me directly on every call.

Connect with Andy on LinkedIn

FAQ

## Frequently Asked Questions

For Recruitment

### How is this different from job boards like Indeed or Reed?

Job boards are passive—you're waiting for companies to post jobs. We're proactive—we go directly to companies that are hiring and book meetings for you. Plus, you only pay for meetings that show up, not for job board subscriptions that may or may not deliver.

For MSPs

### How is this different from Google Ads?

Google Ads are expensive (£5–£15 per click) and most clicks are unqualified. We only charge you for qualified meetings with companies that actually need IT support. No wasted ad spend on tire-kickers.

### I've been burned by marketing agencies before. Why should I trust you?

Fair question. That's why we have a money-back guarantee. If we don't deliver 10 meetings in the first 30 days, you get a full refund. Zero risk. Plus, we're not a typical marketing agency—we specialize exclusively in recruitment and MSPs and understand your business.

For Recruitment

### Do you guarantee placements?

We guarantee qualified meetings with companies that are actively hiring. Whether you close the placement depends on your candidates and your sales process. But we protect you with stipulations—if the companies aren't actually hiring or don't show up, those don't count toward your 10–15 meetings.

For MSPs

### Do you guarantee signed contracts?

We guarantee qualified meetings with companies that have active IT pain points. Whether you close the contract depends on your sales process and pricing. But we protect you with stipulations—if the companies don't actually need IT support or don't show up, those don't count toward your 10–15 meetings.

### How does the guarantee actually work?

If we don't book you a minimum of 10 qualified meetings within 30 days of campaign launch, you pay £0 — no retainer held back, no setup fee retained, no awkward clawback negotiation. We absorb the cost of infrastructure, copy, sending and management. The guarantee is in writing and signed before we start. We can afford to offer it because we don't take on clients we can't deliver for.

### Will cold email damage my main domain reputation?

No — and that's the most common mistake DIY cold email makes. We never send from your primary domain. We register and warm up secondary domains specifically for outbound, fully isolated from the inbox you use for clients and finance. Your main domain stays untouched and protected.

### Where do the leads actually come from? Are they GDPR-compliant?

We build targeted lists using enterprise tools (Apollo, Clay and verified data providers) filtered by industry, headcount, location and decision-maker job title. All B2B outreach is conducted on a legitimate-interest basis under UK GDPR — every email contains a clear unsubscribe and we honour opt-outs immediately. No scraped consumer data. No grey-area lists.

### How long does it take to see results?

Most clients start getting meetings booked within 7–14 days of launching the campaign. By day 30, you should have 10–15 meetings booked.

For Recruitment

### What types of companies do you target?

We target hiring companies of all sizes across your chosen niche. As long as they're actively hiring for the roles you place, we can book meetings with them.

For MSPs

### What industries do you target?

We target SMBs (10–100 employees) across all industries—professional services, healthcare, finance, manufacturing, retail, etc. Any company that needs IT support is a potential client for you.

Let's Talk

## Ready to Book 10–15 Qualified Meetings Per Month?

If you're a South East UK business turning over £5m+ and you want a predictable flow of qualified sales meetings — let's talk. No hard sell. No long contracts.

What happens on this call

- We'll ask about your business, ICP and revenue goals.
- We'll show you exactly what your campaign would look like.

Khrown | Done-For-You B2B Outbound & Cold Email Agency

Done-for-you outbound for B2B teams in Europe and North America

# 25+ qualified meetings with your dream clients in the next 60 days.

We watch your market for buying signals and reach the right companies first, so you get a steady flow of meetings on top of inbound, without hiring more SDRs.

Case study → Case study → Case study → Case study → Case study → Case study → Case study → Case study → Case study → Case study → Case study → Case study → Case study → Case study → Case study → Case study → Case study → Case study → Case study → Case study →

## Most of your market has never heard from you.

Your team only reaches the accounts it has time for.

Your reps are busy closing and your SDRs work the list by hand, so they only ever get to a small part of it.

Your sequences go out and nothing comes back.

The tools are paid for and the emails still send. Most of them land in spam or sound like everyone else's, so nobody answers.

Some months are full, others come up short.

Inbound and events bring in deals when they feel like it. When the month looks thin, there's nothing you can turn up.

Hiring SDRs cost a lot and delivered little.

Salaries, tools and months of ramp add up fast. The meetings never matched the spend.

We've solved this before. Here's what happened.

### 120 Qualified Meetings in 7 Months

54 sales meetings and 66 investor meetings. Including Hyatt, Four Seasons, Sequoia, and a16z.

### 72 Qualified Meetings in 6 Months

10-15 meetings per month, every month. 2 deals closed in the first 60 days.

### 30 Qualified Meetings in 4 Months

### 159 Interested Leads in 9 Months

Including Diageo, PepsiCo, Brown-Forman, Celsius, Haribo, and Thatchers.

## How It Works

1 Day 1-14

### We build it around your best customers.

We look at what was going on at your customers right before they bought, then find companies in that same spot across your market. Meanwhile we buy and warm up your sending domains and inboxes. You sign off on everything before it goes out.

## Book Your Discovery Call.

We're a fit for B2B businesses that

- ✅ Have a proven service/product but no consistent way to fill the pipeline 
- ✅ Are tired of depending on referrals and inbound that comes and goes 
- ✅ Want sales meetings without building an internal outbound team 

This is NOT for you if

- ❌ You don't have a proven offer yet 
- ❌ You don't have any case studies 
- ❌ You can't handle 4+ new sales conversations per week 
- ❌ You want to micromanage every outreach message that goes out 

Hey, I'm Simon Kronberg

Founder, Khrown

Who you're working with

You work with me, Simon. I set the strategy, pick the targets and write the copy. Specialists handle the repetitive work around it. Every result in the case studies above came from that setup.

Most agencies sell you the founder, then hand you to a junior with a template library. There is no junior here to hand you to.

The call is 30 minutes. We look at your market together and I will tell you honestly if outbound will work for it. If it looks good, we book a second call where I walk you through the exact plan. There is no pressure on either call.

What's the guarantee?

We guarantee 10 qualified meetings in your first 60 days of sending. If we book fewer than 10, you get a proportional refund for the meetings we missed.

The 60 days start the day the first email goes out, so the two weeks of warmup don't count against it. A meeting only counts if it actually happens and the person fits the ICP we agreed on at kickoff. If we book someone who doesn't fit, you cancel it and it doesn't count.

That guarantee is also why we say no to some markets. If I do not think we can get you 10 in yours, I will tell you on the first call.

What counts as a qualified meeting?

A meeting counts when the person fits the ICP we agree in writing at kickoff, has a say in the buying decision, and shows up to the call.

If we book someone who doesn't fit, you cancel it and it doesn't count toward the 10.

Is 10 meetings what we should expect?

No - 10 is the floor. It is the number we put money behind, and the goal is to go well past it.

If we hit 10 early, we keep sending at the same volume until the 60 days are up. You get the full window either way.

What we are aiming for is enough meetings that the deals you close pay back the investment many times over, so carrying on with us after the 60 days is an easy call.

How quickly do we see results?

Two weeks of warmup while we build, because fresh domains need it or everything lands in spam. Then campaigns go live, and most clients get their first booked call within the first week of sending.

The properly good numbers come at 60-90 days, once we have enough data to double down on what pulls replies.

Can I see results live?

Yes. From the first send you get a login to your own client portal, where you can see every reply in full, every interested lead and booked meeting, how many people we have reached, and how close we are to 10.

It updates as replies come in, so you never have to wait for a monthly report to know where you stand. Anything else goes in our shared Slack channel.

What if we've tried outbound before and it failed?

Outbound usually fails one link at a time. Sometimes it is the list, sometimes the copy or the offer, sometimes the sending setup - and one weak link is enough to sink the whole chain.

So we own every link. We build the infrastructure, pull and verify the lists, write the copy per company, shape an offer that works on cold traffic, and handle replies through to booked calls. We run it for 60 days, you approve everything on the way, and the whole system is yours to keep afterwards.

What do I keep after the 60 days?

Everything. The sending domains, inboxes, lead lists, all the copy and sequences, and the SOPs for running it.

After the 60 days you run it yourself, hand it to someone on your team, or carry on with us month to month. It is yours either way.

Do I need to do anything?

One kickoff call, about 30 minutes, to nail your ICP, your value props, and any companies you never want us to touch.

After that we handle the rest - lists, copy, sending, replies, booking - and you show up to the calls. You follow it all live in your own client portal, and you get a Slack channel straight to us.

How do you find the right companies and know what to say to them?

We start with research. We look at what was going on at your best customers right before they bought, and we read your market's websites, job posts and the Reddit threads and forums where they vent. That shows us the specific pains each segment has, in the words they use for them.

From there we look for companies in a specific situation. "UK SaaS company" is just a category, but a company that just raised, hired a new VP of Sales and still has no outbound has a reason to talk to you this week - so we find every company in your market that is in that spot right now.

Most companies are not in a moment like that in any given week. Those we group by the pain they are dealing with or the type of company they are, and each group gets its own angle.

We write every email in their own words for their own problems.

How do you keep our customers and pipeline out of it?

At kickoff we load your full do-not-contact list - your customers, your open deals and anyone your team is already working. We block them by email and company domain, so nobody at those companies hears from us on email or LinkedIn.

We can also set up a live sync from your CRM or a Google Sheet, so any new lead from your other channels is kept out of our lists from the moment it comes in.

Will this burn our domain or our brand?

No, because your domain never sends a single cold email. We buy and warm separate sending domains, so if anything takes a hit, it is those domains and nothing else. We monitor them daily and replace any that dip with fresh ones straight away.

On the brand side, every message is written to be useful to the one person reading it, and you approve the messaging before anything goes out. You can also blacklist companies you never want us to touch.

Everyone is doing cold email now. Will prospects even read ours?

Inboxes are crowded, and buyers delete anything that reads mass-sent. A full inbox raises the bar. The channel still works for the campaigns that clear it.

We clear it with timing and specifics. A buying signal tells us a company has a reason to hear from us this week, and the message gets written for that one company, across your whole market. After a thousand-plus campaigns we also know which types of messaging convert, so nothing goes out on a guess.

The offer matters as much as the message. Cold traffic needs a sharper offer than a warm referral does, so we work with you to shape one that stands on its own in a stranger's inbox.

What's the pricing?

It depends on your market and the volume it takes to hit your number, so I price it on the call. Every engagement is priced so the service pays for itself - typically well over five times your investment back in new revenue.

Run your own numbers in the ROI calculator first. If the math does not work for your deal size and close rate, I will be the first to say so.

#### Trusted by leading B2B companies and SaaS brands

### Here's Why Your Pipeline Is Unpredictable

You have a proven product and great service. Clients love you once they start working with you. But getting them in the door? That's where it breaks.

Problem 1

Your paid ads bring in the wrong people

You're spending thousands of dollars each month and getting form fills from people who were never going to buy.

Meanwhile, your actual buyers can't find you — or they click, land on your homepage, and bounce because the message doesn't match what they searched for.

Problem 2

Your outbound is stuck in 2019

Your reps are manually finding contacts on LinkedIn, writing emails one at a time, and following up when they remember. Some months it works. Most months it doesn't. And the moment a rep leaves, the pipeline disappears with them.

Problem 3

You're duct-taping it all together

Ads go to one place. Outbound lives in a spreadsheet. Follow-up happens in someone's inbox. Nothing talks to anything. You have no idea what's actually generating revenue vs. what's just generating activity.

The result: your sales team — who are perfectly capable of closing — sit there waiting for quality conversations that trickle in unpredictably.

### An AI-Powered Go-To-Market System

#### What's included in the Free Growth Plan?

You fill out a 5-minute questionnaire about your business, target market, and current pipeline. Within 48 hours, we send you a personalized Loom video + Google Doc showing how we'd build your GTM system — which channels, which targeting, which offer angles, and what results to expect. No call required unless you want one.

#### Why choose SGA over other agencies?

Most agencies sell you one channel — they're either a Google Ads shop, a cold email shop, or an SEO shop. They optimize for their channel's metrics and leave you to figure out the rest. We build the complete system: funnel, outbound engine, paid ads, and automated nurture — all connected, all feeding one pipeline. You don't manage three vendors and stitch it together yourself. We use AI across the entire system — from signal-based targeting and personalized outreach copy to automated follow-up sequences — which means you get the output of a much larger team at a fraction of the cost. And with performance-based pricing available, we only grow when you grow.
